data_sources.name: OpenRouter model API
data_sources.terms: Public keyless endpoint; data describes commercial listings and links back to openrouter.ai model pages.
data_sources.what_we_use: API model catalog: context windows, per-token pricing, release dates, and open-weight flags for the model sections and API pricing page.

data_sources.name: Hugging Face Hub API
data_sources.terms: Public keyless endpoint; every model links to its own Hub page and licence.
data_sources.what_we_use: Most-downloaded open models per task (LLMs, vision, audio, video, embeddings, robotics, music, OCR and translation), with licence, downloads, and release dates.

data_sources.name: SEC EDGAR
data_sources.terms: US government data, free with a declared User-Agent under SEC fair-access rules; filings link to sec.gov documents.
data_sources.what_we_use: Registrant matching for the company directory: CIK, ticker, exchange, SIC industry, and recent filings for the Public AI Companies section.

data_sources.name: USPTO Open Data Portal
data_sources.terms: Free API key from data.uspto.gov; counts are applicant phrase-match floors covering grants since 2001, and every patent links to its grant record.
data_sources.what_we_use: Granted-patent counts and recent grants per tracked company, matched on applicant name via the Patent File Wrapper search, for the Patents section. Successor to PatentsView, which retired its API when it migrated into ODP in March 2026.

data_sources.name: GitHub REST API
data_sources.terms: Public API within unauthenticated rate limits; every project links to its own repository.
data_sources.what_we_use: Stars, licence, language, and last activity for the curated inference-engine and AI-framework repositories.

data_sources.name: AI provider status pages
data_sources.terms: Keyless public JSON published by each provider for exactly this purpose; incident links open the provider's own record.
data_sources.what_we_use: Current status, degraded components, and 30-day incident counts read from each provider's own public status API for the API Status page.

data_sources.name: SEC EDGAR Form D filings
data_sources.terms: Public-domain US federal filings via EDGAR full-text search with a declared user agent; amounts reported per filing and never summed because amendments restate offerings.
data_sources.what_we_use: Form D exempt-offering disclosures matched to tracked private AI companies by exact issuer name, feeding the Private AI Companies and Funding sections and company pages. Third-party SPV filings that merely carry a company name are excluded, and verified name collisions are curated out.
